effects: Takes exactly `assets` USDC (the vault's immutable asset, 0xb88339…630f) from the signer with transferFrom, so the vault spends that much of the signer's USDC allowance to the vault.
Mints K3USDC vault shares to `onBehalf`. The amount is previewDeposit(assets), priced from the share price after interest and fees accrue in this call, with no minimum.
formats.shown: Deposit 0.01 USDC for <onBehalf>, with the share ticker K3USDC and the share recipient as fields.

findings.title: deposit: the number of K3USDC shares minted is not shown, and there is no minimum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit(): `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. The share price comes from accrueInterest() and adapter realAssets() in storage. Case 0 minted 9998120064368861 K3USDC (0.009998) to the signer; the screen only shows 'Share ticker: K3USDC'.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show this amount because it is not in the calldata. A label such as 'Receive K3USDC shares (amount set by vault price)' would make it clearer.

cases.notes: The 0.01 USDC sent to the vault is shown exactly. The K3USDC shares received are shown by ticker and recipient but not by amount, because the amount is computed on chain. The reader understood that shares arrive but not how many.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Sends exactly `assets` USDC from the vault to `receiver`, after the vault pulls liquidity from its liquidity adapter if needed.
Burns previewWithdraw(assets) K3USDC shares from `onBehalf`. The amount is rounded up from the current share price, with no maximum.
If the signer is not `onBehalf`, uses up `onBehalf`'s share allowance to the signer by the number of shares burned (unless that allowance is unlimited).
formats.shown: Withdraw 25000 USDC to <receiver>, with the exact amount, the receiver and the owner whose shares are used as fields.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of K3USDC shares burned is not shown, and there is no maximum.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw(): `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);`. exit() calls `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`. Case 1 burned 24984.383116174995233268 K3USDC from the signer; the screen shows only 'Withdraw exactly 25000 USDC' and 'Owner'.
findings.fix: The amount is not in the calldata, so the descriptor cannot show it. A label like 'Owner (K3USDC shares burned)' would at least say that shares are spent.

findings.title: withdraw: the intent sentence leaves out the owner whose shares are burned.
findings.evidence: exit(): `if (msg.sender != onBehalf) { ... allowance[onBehalf][msg.sender] = _allowance - shares; }` and `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares)`. interpolatedIntent is 'Withdraw {#.assets} to {#.receiver}'; onBehalf appears only as the field 'Owner'.

cases.notes: The 25000 USDC received by the signer is shown exactly, with the right receiver. The K3USDC shares burned (about 24984.38) have no amount on screen. The reader guessed that 'my position/share' leaves but saw no amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns exactly `shares` K3USDC shares from `onBehalf`. If the signer is not `onBehalf`, this uses up `onBehalf`'s share allowance to the signer.
Sends previewRedeem(shares) USDC from the vault to `receiver`. The amount is rounded down from the current share price, with no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem 0.009998 K3USDC to <receiver>, with the shares, the receiver and the owner as fields. The asset paid out (USDC) is never named.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never says that USDC is what the receiver gets.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol exit(): `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets)`, where asset is the immutable USDC 0xb88339…630f. The descriptor has constants.underlyingTicker 'USDC', but the redeem fields are only 'Shares to redeem', 'To' and 'Owner'. In case 2 the reader wrote 'Some amount of the underlying asset (probably USDC)'.
findings.fix: Use the intent 'Redeem {#.shares} for USDC to {#.receiver}', or add a raw field 'Receive' with value $.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker, as deposit does for the share ticker.

findings.title: redeem: the USDC amount paid out is set on chain, and there is no minimum.
findings.evidence: redeem(): `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);`. Case 2 paid 10000 (0.01 USDC) to the signer; no amount appears on screen.
findings.fix: The amount is not in the calldata, so the descriptor cannot show it.

cases.notes: The 0.009998120064368861 K3USDC burned is shown exactly. The 0.01 USDC received has no amount and no asset on screen. The reader only guessed USDC.

redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver,.worst: redeem: the screen never says that USDC is what the receiver gets.
